_about: Diagram sources as the daemon serves them (FEAT-203 R-2): a TOGAF board's Workflow page and its Gantt page. Regenerate from a scratch board when the daemon's output changes.
workflow:
stateDiagram-v2
    state "Business Arch" as Business_Arch
    state "No Action" as No_Action
    state "Not Applicable" as Not_Applicable
    state "Out-of-Scope" as Out_of_Scope
    state "System Design" as System_Design
    [*] --> Vision
    Business_Arch --> System_Design
    Business_Arch --> Vision
    Business_Arch --> No_Action
    Business_Arch --> Not_Applicable
    Business_Arch --> Out_of_Scope
    Implementation --> Migration
    Implementation --> Operations
    Implementation --> System_Design
    Implementation --> No_Action
    Implementation --> Not_Applicable
    Implementation --> Out_of_Scope
    Migration --> Operations
    Migration --> Implementation
    Migration --> No_Action
    Migration --> Not_Applicable
    Migration --> Out_of_Scope
    No_Action --> Vision
    Not_Applicable --> Vision
    Operations --> Migration
    Operations --> No_Action
    Operations --> Not_Applicable
    Operations --> Out_of_Scope
    Out_of_Scope --> Vision
    System_Design --> Implementation
    System_Design --> Business_Arch
    System_Design --> No_Action
    System_Design --> Not_Applicable
    System_Design --> Out_of_Scope
    Vision --> Business_Arch
    Vision --> No_Action
    Vision --> Not_Applicable
    Vision --> Out_of_Scope
    Operations --> [*]
    note right of No_Action: no-op (inert disposition)
    note right of Not_Applicable: no-op (inert disposition)
    note right of Out_of_Scope: no-op (inert disposition)
    note left of Business_Arch: needs statement, goals, zachman who/what/why, requirements, ears, approved
    note left of System_Design: needs zachman how/where, approved
    note left of Implementation: needs tests named, approved, spec sections Design, sign-off design-review
    note left of Migration: needs tests green, docs updated, sign-off docs-folded
    note left of Operations: needs tests green, sign-off release
gantt:
gantt
    title demo
    dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
    axisFormat %m-%d
    section MS-001
    demo/FEAT-001 :crit, demo_FEAT_001, 2026-10-21, 1d
    demo/FEAT-002 :demo_FEAT_002, 2026-10-21, 1d
